svg.title: Становая тяга со штангой на одной ноге — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Single-leg barbell deadlift, three-quarter side view. Left: upright on exactly one working foot, the other foot a little off floor behind, holding one straight barbell in both hands at thighs. Right: hinge forward from working hip, torso neutral spine near horizontal, free leg extends straight BACK in line with torso and clearly off ground, working foot flat in same place with only small knee bend, shoulders and pelvis square. Arms straight hang toward floor and hold barbell close to working shin, no ground contact. Same person, weight, single support leg and three-quarter camera in both frames. No kickstand contact or split squat. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
